uxmode.name: Interface mode
uxmode.description: Simple/advanced interface switch with per-feature overrides

header.simpleTitle: Simple interface: professional features are hidden
header.advancedTitle: Pro interface: every feature is visible
header.firstRun: The interface starts in simple mode. Switch between Simple and Pro in the header or in Settings.

settings.advancedHint: Show every professional surface: statistics, tags, reservations, returns, tracking, grid editing and more.
settings.featuresHint: Each feature belongs to the Simple or the Pro tier. The switches set what the simple interface shows — flip one either way; Pro mode always shows everything.
settings.groupAllAria: Show every {plugin} feature in Simple mode
settings.groupNoneAria: Hide every {plugin} feature in Simple mode
